Identify new lab adverse event to report

Source: R/labAE.R
labAE.Rd

A function to identify new lab adverse event to report from a vector of consecutive lab adverse event grade.

Usage

labAE(data, gradecut)

Arguments

data

a numeric vector of consecutive lab adverse event grade.

gradecut

a grade threshold to report.

Value

A factor (levels "Yes", "No") of the same length as `data`: "Yes" when the grade reaches `gradecut` and is higher than the previous grade (or is the first value), `NA` where the grade is missing.

Examples

# grades of one patient over consecutive visits; report grade >= 3
labAE(c(0, 1, 3, 3, 2, 4), gradecut = 3)
#> [1] No  No  Yes No  No  Yes
#> Levels: Yes No

# per patient, with dplyr
visits <- data.frame(id = rep(1:2, each = 3), grade = c(1, 3, 3, 3, 2, 4))
dplyr::mutate(dplyr::group_by(visits, id), new_ae = labAE(grade, gradecut = 3))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#> # Groups:   id [2]
#>      id grade new_ae
#>   <int> <dbl> <fct> 
#> 1     1     1 No    
#> 2     1     3 Yes   
#> 3     1     3 No    
#> 4     2     3 Yes   
#> 5     2     2 No    
#> 6     2     4 Yes
